name: Indie Publishing
tagline: Complete 25-page Indie Publishing display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.

palette.description: Source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, tables and image treatments; not normalized across templates.

typography.style: Manrope display with Manrope body; original source font-family roles, declared weights, sizes and frames retained. Original unmodified font files are embedded with their own licenses; font versions are recorded. No common font substitution.

best_for: Contemporary publishing, cultural institutions, creative studio narratives and photographic research stories with editorial multi-column typography.
avoid_for: Dense financial tables, strict corporate reporting, or lengthy text that cannot be split across editorial pages.
